title: Mechanism of Nicotiflorin in San-Ye-Qing rhizome for anti-inflammatory effect in ulcerative colitis.
authors: Ruan, Yun; Zhu, Xiaolin; Shen, Jianbo; Chen, Hao; Zhou, Guoxiong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药三叶青根茎粉末中烟花苷通过靶向p65抑制NF-κB通路治疗溃疡性结肠炎，属于纯药理学与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The incidence of ulcerative colitis (UC) is on the rise globally and the development of drugs targeting UC is urgent. Finding the target of action of natural products is important for drug discovery, elucidation of drug action mechanism, and disease mechanism. San-Ye-Qing (SYQ), is an ancient herbal medicine, but whether the powder of its rhizome has pharmacological effects against UC and its mechanism of action are not clear. PURPOSE: To evaluate the therapeutic effectiveness of rhizome powder of SYQ in treating UC, and conduct an isolation and characterization of the chemical constituents of the powder. Further, screen the most potent compounds among them and determine the potential mechanism for treating UC. METHODS: In vivo, the therapeutic effect of SYQ's rhizome powder on UC was assessed by mice's body weight, DAI score, colon length, tissue MPO activity, serum inflammatory markers, etc. Additionally, HPLC was used to isolate and identify the specific chemical components of SYQ's rhizome powder. Then, the most effective compounds and their therapeutic targets were analysed and screened in SYQ rhizome powder using network pharmacology, combined with CCK-8 assay, NO release assay and molecular docking assay, in conjunction with CETSA, DARTS, SPR and enzyme activity assay. Finally, the biological effects of the key compound on the targets were validated using Western blot and ELISA. RESULTS: In vivo, SYQ rhizome powder effectively restored mice's body weight, lowered DAI and pathological score, downregulated the expression of inflammatory biomarkers, and restored colon length, as well as the colonic epithelial and mucus barriers. Afterward, 9 compounds were isolated and identified from the powder of the rhizomes of SYQ by HPLC. Nicotiflorin is the primary compound in SYQ with the highest concentration. According to both CCK-8 and NO release tests, Nicotiflorin is also the most efficacious compound. Combined with network pharmacological prediction, molecular docking analysis, CETSA, DARTS, SPR and enzyme activity assay, Nicotiflorin may ultimately suppress inflammation by targeting p65 and inhibiting the NF-kappaB pathway, thereby attenuating the activation of NLRP3 inflammasome. To verify this conclusion, Western blot and ELISA experiments were conducted. CONCLUSIONS: Our results suggest that the extract from SYQ rhizomes has therapeutic properties for UC. Its active ingredient Nicotiflorin exerted potent anti-UC effects by binding to p65 and inhibiting the activation of NF-kappaB and NLRP3 inflammasomes.
abstract_zh: 背景：溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）的发病率在全球范围内呈上升趋势，开发针对UC的药物迫在眉睫。寻找天然产物的作用靶点对于药物发现、阐明药物作用机制及疾病机制具有重要意义。三叶青（San-Ye-Qing, SYQ）是一种古老的草药，但其根茎粉末是否具有抗UC的药理作用及其作用机制尚不清楚。目的：评估SYQ根茎粉末治疗UC的疗效，并对其粉末中的化学成分进行分离和鉴定。进一步筛选其中最具活性的化合物，并确定其治疗UC的潜在机制。方法：在体内实验中，通过小鼠体重、疾病活动指数（DAI）评分、结肠长度、组织髓过氧化物酶（MPO）活性、血清炎症标志物等指标评估SYQ根茎粉末对UC的治疗效果。此外，采用高效液相色谱（HPLC）分离并鉴定SYQ根茎粉末中的特定化学成分。然后，利用网络药理学，结合CCK-8实验、一氧化氮（NO）释放实验和分子对接实验，并联合细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、药物亲和反应靶标稳定性分析（DARTS）、表面等离子体共振（SPR）和酶活性实验，对SYQ根茎粉末中最有效的化合物及其治疗靶点进行分析和筛选。最后，使用Western blot和ELISA验证关键化合物对靶点的生物学效应。结果：在体内实验中，SYQ根茎粉末有效恢复小鼠体重，降低DAI和病理评分，下调炎症生物标志物的表达，并恢复结肠长度以及结肠上皮和黏液屏障。随后，通过HPLC从SYQ根茎粉末中分离并鉴定出9种化合物。烟花苷（Nicotiflorin）是SYQ中含量最高的主要化合物。根据CCK-8和NO释放实验，烟花苷也是最有效的化合物。结合网络药理学预测、分子对接分析、CETSA、DARTS、SPR和酶活性实验，烟花苷可能通过靶向p65并抑制NF-kappaB通路，从而减弱NLRP3炎症小体的激活，最终抑制炎症。为验证这一结论，进行了Western blot和ELISA实验。结论：我们的结果表明，SYQ根茎提取物对UC具有治疗特性。其活性成分烟花苷通过结合p65并抑制NF-kappaB和NLRP3炎症小体的激活，发挥了强效的抗UC作用。
